title: Measurement retention
help: Manage stored sensor measurements. Plant history and files are not affected.
active: A purge is queued or running. Counts refresh automatically.
receiptGuard: Only measurements whose observation and receipt are both older than this age are eligible.
confirmManual: This permanently deletes the eligible measurements before the displayed cutoff. A backup is required to recover them.
confirmPolicy: This enables daily automatic deletion and starts a purge now. Deleted measurements can only be recovered from a backup.
preserved: Plant events, alert snapshots, inventory and security history are preserved. Charts and new exports will use the remaining measurements.

errors.conflict: Settings changed. Reload and preview again.
errors.previewExpired: This preview expired or belongs to another session. Preview again.
errors.busy: A purge is already pending. Wait or stop it first.
errors.failed: The purge could not be completed. Check the queue and reload.
errors.authorization: Authorization changed. The purge was stopped.
errors.queueUnavailable: Configure an asynchronous queue before starting a purge.

policyHelp: Automatically delete measurements older than the chosen number of days, every day. Enabling or changing this rule also starts a purge immediately.
manualHelp: Delete old measurements once, after reviewing the preview. This does not change the automatic retention rule.
